:= by
  -- Show f '' (f '' s) ⊆ s
  have h1 : f '' (f '' s) ⊆ s :=
    Set.image_subset_iff.mpr
      (fun x => 
        Set.image_subset_iff.mpr
          (fun y => 
            hf y))
  -- Show s ⊆ f '' (f '' s)
  have h2 : s ⊆ f '' (f '' s) :=
    Set.image_subset_iff.mpr
      (fun x => 
        Set.image_subset_iff.mpr
          (fun y => 
            hf y))
  -- Combine both to get equality
  exact Set.ext h1 h2
